description: This file defines a custom view component 'SlidingTabLayout' used in Android applications for creating a horizontal scrollable tab strip linked with a ViewPager. It provides customizable tab views, indicator colors, and supports interaction with ViewPager to display tab indicators and handle scrolling.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView that displays tabs in sync with a ViewPager, allowing users to navigate between pages with visual indicators and customizable tab views.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface to provide custom colors for the tab indicator and dividers based on tab position.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView to be used as a tab if no custom layout is set.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Populates the tab strip with views representing each page in the ViewPager.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the tab container to ensure the selected tab is visible.
